preview_heading: Kings meet Patriots in Gros Islet
preview: Saint Lucia Kings face St Kitts & Nevis Patriots in CPL 2026 Match 5 at Daren Sammy Cricket Ground. The match is scheduled for Wed 12 Aug at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: Roston Chase and Matthew Forde anchor the returning group, joined by Jewel Andrew and a fresh Saint Lucian pathway that includes McKenny Clarke. The Patriots unite CPL's leading career run-scorer Johnson Charles with Andre Fletcher, while Jason Holder returns to strengthen an experienced Caribbean group. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
